messages:
alex chen: quick heads up — canary for redwood/llama-3-13b (AWQ + act-quant) is showing quality regressions after we changed act group_size to 64. not critical yet but reproducible on our small eval set.

samir: which metric is moving? error examples?

alex chen: exact-match down ~0.9% on the internal question-answering harness; token-repeat rate up ~1.2%. ppl spikes around certain prompts. reproduced locally with seed replay.

jia: is this the group_size change from 128->64 in the rollout? any other knobs flipped (scale, clipping)?

alex chen: correct — only changed group_size and enabled the faster int path. no clipping changes. config snippet: 
```
act_quant:
  enabled: true
  group_size: 64
  threshold: 0.02
fast_path: int8_fused: true
```

mira: can you paste a short failing decode trace?

alex chen: snippet below from the reproduce run (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-20T10:14:12Z] decode WARN repeated-token-loop model=redwood/llama-3-13b-awq act_group=64 prompt_id=abc123
[2026-03-20T10:14:12Z] logits: top5 ["the", "a", "the", "the", "and"] prob mass 0.68
[2026-03-20T10:14:12Z] perplexity jump +3.8 at token 24
```

rohan: @alex can we bisect to confirm group_size is causal? maybe try group_size=96 and 112 as quick checks.

alex chen: started a quick grid: 128 (baseline) -> 96 -> 80 -> 64. early results: 96 is near-baseline, 80 slight degradation, 64 worst. linking PR with bench logs: https://git.internal/r/awq/PR-482

samir: any perf wins from 64 that tempted the change? latency impact?

alex chen: p95 latency down ~2-3ms on this model (small win) but cost savings minimal. tradeoff not worth the quality delta.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started by @alex chen at 3694567902 — target: 10% traffic on dedicated pool.

mira: i'd prefer revert to 128 for now and re-run canary with extra eval gating. agree?

rohan: +1 revert. also add a lightweight regression test that runs the top 50 prompts from the prod error cases.

alex chen: will open the revert PR now and add the extra eval hook. planning hotpatch rollout in ~30m after tests.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: revert PR merged (r/awq/PR-483) by alex chen at 3694567928. canary rollback initiated.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: rollback completed at 3694567950. traffic back to baseline.

samir: nice. postmortem suggestion: add an automatic act-quant sweep in the pre-rollout CI that compares quality deltas against baseline and flags >0.5% EM drop.

mira: also capture token-entropy traces per prompt in the canary dashboard so we can pinpoint patterns (repetitions, low-divergence traps).

alex chen: agreed on both. I'll schedule the CI sweep and add token-entropy traces to the canary dashboard. thanks for quick responses :thumbsup:

rohan: file a short incident note with the reproducer and the grid results so we can reference during the next quant bakeoff.

alex chen: will do — i'll attach logs and the mini-bench csv in the incident note.

mira: moving to close here unless anyone sees more to add.

alex chen: closing — will post follow-ups in the bakeoff thread once CI sweep runs.
